study type: Prospective observational sub-study of a global registry
outcome: Clinical worsening (composite of all-cause death, cardiovascular rehospitalization, or decline in LVEF)
Worsening of New York Heart Association class
Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) at follow-up
cohort: Women with peri-partum cardiomyopathy (PPCM) who underwent subsequent pregnancies (SSPs), recruited from a global registry between 2012 and 2023.
finding: Maternal morbidity and mortality rates during subsequent pregnancies in women with PPCM were lower than anticipated, with baseline LVEF <50% not associated with increased adverse maternal outcomes, but women with LVEF ≥50% experienced a decline in LVEF.
followup_time: Median 198 days (inter-quartile range 160-240) from the end of the SSP
